Agent Name: PublicationData_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: PublicationData_Expert incorrectly assumed the false positive rate to be 5% based on a p-value threshold of 0.05, without considering that the actual average p-value provided in the problem is 0.04, which is below the threshold. The false positive rate should instead correspond to the proportion of p-values below 0.05 that are false positives. This misinterpretation led to an incorrect calculation of the number of incorrect papers, which should have been 41 instead of 50.
